author: Raydn
quote: There are restrictions in this game that shouldn't be there, especially for a GTA game. The whole point of GTA is being able to do whatever you want. That freedom is what makes it feel like GTA. The story and characters are boring and barely develop throughout the game. Story, characters, and good missions are what make GTA feel like GTA, and this one missed all of it. Save your money and wait for a sale. Really disappointing for a "GTA" game.
